technique_name: Describe the different techniques used to predict weather
description: Weather forecasting relies on a variety of techniques and tools, including both numerical and statistical methods. Numerical methods involve the use of complex weather models to simulate and predict weather on local and global scales. Statistical methods use historical data to infer future weather patterns and trends.
